description: Several high-value optimizations were absent across all panel responses: - **Connection multiplexing** beyond HTTP/2 (e.g., database pipelining, gRPC streaming for data-heavy endpoints) - **Materialized views** for complex aggregations queried repeatedly - **Query result streaming** for large dataset exports (avoids full in-memory buffering) - **Cache preheating** on deploy to avoid thundering-herd against a cold cache - **Serialization optimization** (zero-copy, schema-based serializers like FlatBuffers or Cap'n Proto for internal services) - **Database maintenance routines** (regular VACUUM, ANALYZE, index rebuild schedules) These are worth investigating alongside Tier 2/3 items once the foundational optimizations are in place.
